name: walled-dome
why: The upper half of a sphere of radius 40, from its equator at z = 0 to a closed cap at z = 39.5 (9 degrees off horizontal), lofted through 40 fitted circles as a 2 mm wall. The mirror image of walled-bowl: the outer cap 0..39.5 less the radius-38 cap 0..37.5, 19116.068 mm3 in closed form. loft_wall_mm must read 2.000.
